description: This file defines a sealed class 'ColumnColors' and nested static classes for Chart Colors in the PdfSharp.Charting.Renderers namespace. It provides predefined color sets for column/bar, line, and pie charts using color values taken from Excel, represented as static readonly uint arrays, and offers methods to retrieve color objects based on index.

classes.name: ColumnColors
classes.description: Represents predefined color sets for chart columns/bars, line charts, and pie charts in a sealed class with static methods and nested static classes.

methods.name: Item
methods.description: Retrieves an XColor object for column/bar charts based on a given index using the predefined SeriesColorValues array.

methods.name: Item
methods.description: Retrieves an XColor object for line charts based on a given index using the predefined LineColorValues array.

methods.name: Item
methods.description: Retrieves an XColor object for pie charts based on a given index using the predefined SectorColorValues array.
